title: Credit Standing on a Hotel Reservation Where the Property Has Given Notice
content:
The credit standing on a reservation in the Hotel Rate Plans range, from which the closing credit release is worked out, is read from the property notices on the folio and from how the departure date lies against the day the release is settled.

Where the folio carries a property notice about the reservation and the departure date is no later than the day the release is settled, the credit standing is the arrival grant in full, the uses already posted being set aside. Where the folio carries no property notice about the reservation and the departure date is no later than the day the release is settled, the credit standing is nil. In every other case the credit standing is the arrival grant less every use already posted to the credit account.

*The combinations, on hypothetical figures.* Take an arrival grant of 120.00 USD against which 45.00 USD of use already stands.

- A property notice on the folio, departure the same day as the release is settled: the credit standing is 120.00 USD, the 45.00 USD of use being set aside.
- A property notice on the folio, departure the day before the release is settled: the departure date is again no later than that day, so the credit standing is 120.00 USD.
- No property notice, departure the same day as the release is settled: the credit standing is nil, whatever the grant.
- No property notice, departure two days after the release is settled: the departure date is later than the day of settlement, so the credit standing is 120.00 USD less 45.00 USD, or 75.00 USD.
- A property notice on the folio, departure two days after the release is settled: the departure date is again later than the day of settlement, so the credit standing is likewise 75.00 USD.
